projects.label: E-Scooter Riders
projects.text: How e-scooter riders scan the road and respond to traffic, studied with instrumented e-scooters and a motion-platform simulator.

projects.label: Adolescent Micromobility Safety

projects.label: Pedestrian Attention
projects.text: Where pedestrians look and how safe they feel at crossings, by day and at night, on Charlottesville streets and in VR.

projects.label: Seeing the City
